items.en: Excuse me, are you Michael by any chance? I'm Rainbow from Sunway.
items.cn: 打扰一下，请问您是 Michael 吗？我是思威公司的 Rainbow。

items.en: Welcome to Shanghai — I hope the flight wasn't too tiring.
items.cn: 欢迎来到上海，一路还顺利吧？

items.en: Here, let me take that bag for you.
items.cn: 行李我来帮您拿吧。

items.en: The car is waiting just outside; it's about forty minutes to the hotel.
items.cn: 车就在外面等着，到酒店大概四十分钟。

items.en: Take your time — there's no rush on our side.
items.cn: 您慢慢来，我们这边不赶时间。

items.en: If you'd like to freshen up first, the restroom is just around the corner.
items.cn: 如果您想先洗漱一下，洗手间就在拐角。

items.en: So, how was the flight? Did you manage to get any sleep?
items.cn: 这一路怎么样，飞机上睡着了吗？

items.en: It's your first time in China, isn't it?
items.cn: 您第一次来中国吧？

items.en: We've got about forty minutes, so feel free to rest if you're tired.
items.cn: 还有四十分钟左右，您要是累了就先歇会儿。

items.en: I booked you into the Hilton — it's about ten minutes from the office.
items.cn: 我给您订的是希尔顿，离公司十分钟左右。

items.en: If there's anything you need during your stay, just let me know.
items.cn: 这段时间有任何需要，随时跟我说。

items.en: Oh, before I forget — here's a local SIM card with the Wi-Fi details.
items.cn: 对了差点忘了，这是本地电话卡，Wi-Fi 信息也在里面。

items.en: Good morning — do you have an appointment with anyone?
items.cn: 早上好，请问您有预约吗？

items.en: Could I ask you to sign in here, please?
items.cn: 麻烦您在这里登记一下。

items.en: Let me get you a visitor badge; please wear it while you're on the floor.
items.cn: 我给您拿个访客牌，在办公区请随身戴着。

items.en: I'll let Mr. Chen know you've arrived.
items.cn: 我去通知陈总您到了。

items.en: Please make yourself comfortable — can I get you a coffee or tea?
items.cn: 您先随便坐，喝点咖啡还是茶？

items.en: He'll be with you shortly.
items.cn: 他马上就过来。

items.en: Let me introduce you to everyone before we get started.
items.cn: 开始前我先介绍一下在座的各位。

items.en: This is David, who heads our quality team.
items.cn: 这位是 David，负责我们的质量团队。

items.en: David, this is Michael — he's visiting from Germany this week.
items.cn: David，这位是 Michael，这周从德国过来。

items.en: He'll be your main contact while you're here.
items.cn: 您在这边的对接人主要是他。

items.en: Anything technical, David is your man.
items.cn: 技术上有什么问题，找 David 就对了。

items.en: Shall we get started?
items.cn: 那我们开始吧？

items.en: Here's my card — my WeChat ID is on the back.
items.cn: 这是我的名片，背面有我的微信号。

items.en: Sorry, I've just run out of cards; let me add you on WeChat instead.
items.cn: 不好意思名片刚好发完了，那我加您微信吧。

items.en: Let me scan your QR code.
items.cn: 我扫一下您的二维码。

items.en: Keep it — I have plenty.
items.cn: 您留着吧，我这儿还有很多。

items.en: I'll send you the meeting notes afterward.
items.cn: 回头我把会议纪要发给您。

items.en: Nice to finally put a face to the name.
items.cn: 终于见到本人了。

items.en: Please come this way — we'll be in the second meeting room.
items.cn: 这边请，我们在第二会议室。

items.en: Sit wherever you like; there's no seating plan.
items.cn: 您随便坐，没有固定座次。

items.en: Would you prefer tea, coffee, or just water?
items.cn: 您喝茶、咖啡，还是白水就好？

items.en: Let me know if the room is too warm and I'll adjust it.
items.cn: 如果觉得屋里热，告诉我一声，我来调。

items.en: Shall we wait a few minutes for the others?
items.cn: 要不要再等一会儿其他同事？

items.en: USB ports and adapters are here if you need them.
items.cn: 这边有 USB 接口和转换头，需要的话自取。

items.en: Thanks for making the trip — it means a lot to us.
items.cn: 感谢您专程过来，我们很看重这次见面。

items.en: I'll keep this to about fifteen minutes, then we'll have plenty of time for questions.
items.cn: 我大概讲十五分钟，之后留足时间给大家提问。

items.en: Feel free to stop me along the way if anything isn't clear.
items.cn: 中途哪里不清楚，随时打断我都可以。

items.en: Let me start with who we are and what we do.
items.cn: 我先讲一下我们是谁、做什么。

items.en: We were founded in 2012, and today we're around three hundred people.
items.cn: 我们2012年成立，现在三百人左右。

items.en: In short, we help brands get their products made in Asia.
items.cn: 简单说，我们帮品牌客户在亚洲完成产品制造。

items.en: Let me walk you through the numbers.
items.cn: 我过一下数据。

items.en: We serve about forty clients across Europe and North America.
items.cn: 我们在欧洲和北美服务大约四十家客户。

items.en: Around seventy percent of our output goes to repeat customers.
items.cn: 大约七成的产能是给回头客户的。

items.en: We run two plants — one here, one in Vietnam.
items.cn: 我们有两个厂区，一个在这里，一个在越南。

items.en: Last year we shipped just over two million units.
items.cn: 去年我们出货两百多万台。

items.en: I can share the detailed figures after the meeting.
items.cn: 详细数据我会在会后发给您。

items.en: So what really sets us apart?
items.cn: 那我们的差异点到底在哪呢？

items.en: It comes down to three things: speed, quality, and communication.
items.cn: 归起来是三点：速度、质量，还有沟通。

items.en: Most factories can hit the quality bar; very few reply to emails within an hour.
items.cn: 质量达标大多数厂都做得到，但邮件一小时内回的不多。

items.en: You'll have one dedicated contact — no bouncing between departments.
items.cn: 您只有一个专属对接人，不会被在各个部门之间踢来踢去。

items.en: We don't take every order we're offered, and that's deliberate.
items.cn: 不是什么订单我们都接，这是我们有意为之。

items.en: At the end of the day, we'd rather be reliable than cheap.
items.cn: 说到底，我们宁愿做到可靠，也不愿只图便宜。

items.en: Good question — let me make sure I understood it right.
items.cn: 问得好，我先确认一下有没有理解对。

items.en: I don't want to guess, so let me check and come back to you.
items.cn: 我不想凭猜的，核实之后回复您。

items.en: Off the top of my head, it's around ninety thousand units a month.
items.cn: 凭印象说，一个月大概九万台。

items.en: We ran into that once; let me show you how we solved it.
items.cn: 这个问题我们遇到过一次，我讲讲当时怎么解决的。

items.en: Let me put that question to our engineering team.
items.cn: 这个问题我去问一下工程团队。

items.en: Anything else before we move on?
items.cn: 还有别的吗？没有的话我们继续。

items.en: I've put together a folder with our company profile and catalogue.
items.cn: 我准备了一份文件夹，里面是公司简介和产品目录。

items.en: Please take one — there's a USB drive inside as well.
items.cn: 请拿一份，里面还有一张 U 盘。

items.en: And this is a small gift from our team — nothing expensive, just local.
items.cn: 这是我们团队的一点心意，不值什么钱，就是些当地特产。

items.en: I hope you don't mind; it's just a token.
items.cn: 希望您别介意，就是一点小心意。

items.en: I can send you a digital copy instead if that's easier.
items.cn: 如果您觉得电子版更方便，我可以发给您。

items.en: If it's too much to carry, we'll ship everything to your office.
items.cn: 要是拿着不方便，我们把资料寄到您公司。

items.en: Before we head in, a few housekeeping points.
items.cn: 进去之前，我先说几件注意事项。

items.en: Please put on these safety glasses and the visitor vest.
items.cn: 请戴上这副护目镜，穿上访客背心。

items.en: Photography isn't allowed in this area, sorry about that.
items.cn: 这个区域不允许拍照，实在抱歉。

items.en: Watch your step here — the floor can be slippery.
items.cn: 这里小心脚下，地面有点滑。

items.en: If anything alarms you, just say so and we'll step right out.
items.cn: 觉得哪里不对劲随时说，我们立刻退出来。

items.en: Shall we go in?
items.cn: 那我们进去？

items.en: This is where our project teams sit; it's mostly open plan.
items.cn: 这是项目组的办公区，基本是开放式的。

items.en: Each team runs a short stand-up every morning at nine.
items.cn: 每个小组每天早上九点开一个短会。

items.en: That glass room is where we take client calls.
items.cn: 那间玻璃房是我们和客户打电话、开视频会的地方。

items.en: The walls are writable, so ideas go up and tend to stay up.
items.cn: 墙面可以直接写字，想法写上去就留着了。

items.en: If something urgent comes in, everyone here drops what they're doing.
items.cn: 一旦有紧急情况，这里所有人都会放下手上的活。

items.en: Let's keep walking — I'll show you the lab next.
items.cn: 我们接着往前走，下面带您看实验室。

items.en: This line has been running for about eight hours today.
items.cn: 这条线今天已经开了八小时左右。

items.en: We run two shifts, twelve hours each.
items.cn: 我们两班倒，每班十二小时。

items.en: Everything you see here is assembled by hand; it's very skilled work.
items.cn: 您看到的这些都是手工装配的，很吃手艺。

items.en: Please stay behind the yellow line.
items.cn: 请您站在黄线外面。

items.en: This station used to be the bottleneck, so we added a second operator here.
items.cn: 这个工位以前是瓶颈，所以我们在这儿加了一个人。

items.en: You can ask anyone here anything — most of them speak a little English.
items.cn: 这里的工人您都可以问，多数人会说一点英语。

items.en: This machine came online last March.
items.cn: 这台设备是去年三月份上的。

items.en: It runs at about ninety percent utilisation, so there's still some headroom.
items.cn: 它的利用率大约九成，所以还有余量。

items.en: Monthly output here is around ninety thousand units.
items.cn: 这边的月产量大概九万台。

items.en: We can add another shift if the volume picks up.
items.cn: 如果订单量上来，我们可以再加一个班。

items.en: Maintenance is done every two weeks, without exception.
items.cn: 设备每两周保养一次，雷打不动。

items.en: Lead times usually stretch in the fourth quarter, so we plan ahead.
items.cn: 第四季度交期通常会拉长，所以我们提前排产。

items.en: Nothing leaves this floor without passing inspection.
items.cn: 过了质检才能出厂，这是硬规矩。

items.en: We check at three points: incoming materials, the line itself, and final shipment.
items.cn: 我们查三道关：来料、产线、出货。

items.en: This is the defect log from last week; you're welcome to read it.
items.cn: 这是上周的不良品记录，您可以随便看。

items.en: Our current first-pass yield is ninety-nine point two percent.
items.cn: 我们目前的一次合格率是99.2%。

items.en: If anything looks off, the line has the authority to stop it.
items.cn: 一旦出现异常，产线有权直接停线。

items.en: Is there anything you'd like us to test specifically?
items.cn: 有什么是您特别希望我们测的吗？

items.en: So, what do you think so far?
items.cn: 到现在为止，您觉得怎么样？

items.en: Is there anything you expected to see but haven't yet?
items.cn: 有没有本来想看、但还没看到的？

items.en: Take your time — there's no need to rush through it.
items.cn: 您慢慢看，不用赶。

items.en: If you'd like, we can stop here and have a quick chat with the team.
items.cn: 如果您愿意，我们可以在这儿停一下，跟团队聊两句。

items.en: Would you like a photo in front of the line?
items.cn: 要不要在产线这边拍张照？

items.en: Whenever you're ready, we can move on.
items.cn: 您看好了，我们就继续。

items.en: Let's start with what you're actually looking for.
items.cn: 我们先聊聊您具体要什么。

items.en: Could you walk me through your current setup first?
items.cn: 您能先讲讲你们目前的情况吗？

items.en: Is this a new project, or are you replacing an existing supplier?
items.cn: 这是新项目，还是说要替换现有供应商？

items.en: What's a must-have, and what's just nice to have?
items.cn: 哪些是必须要有的，哪些只是加分项？

items.en: Who else is quoting on this, if you don't mind me asking?
items.cn: 方便的话问一下，还有哪些供应商在报价？

items.en: Is there anything we should absolutely avoid?
items.cn: 有什么是我们绝对不能碰的？

items.en: Let me give you a ballpark figure first.
items.cn: 我先给您一个大概的价格。

items.en: That's based on an order quantity of ten thousand units.
items.cn: 这个价格是按一万台的订单量算的。

items.en: Payment terms are thirty percent deposit and seventy percent before shipment.
items.cn: 付款方式是三成定金，出货前付清七成。

items.en: The quote is valid for thirty days.
items.cn: 这份报价三十天内有效。

items.en: We accept both T/T and L/C; either works for us.
items.cn: 电汇和信用证我们都接受，两种都可以。

items.en: If the volume goes up, there's room to move on price.
items.cn: 如果量能上来，价格上还有空间。

items.en: Lead time is around forty-five days after sample approval.
items.cn: 交期是样品确认之后大约四十五天。

items.en: That assumes nothing changes on your side.
items.cn: 这个时间是假设你们这边没有变化。

items.en: We can shave a week off if you can confirm early.
items.cn: 如果您能早点确认，我们可以提前一周。

items.en: Shipping to Rotterdam adds another twenty-five days.
items.cn: 运到鹿特丹还要再加二十五天。

items.en: We'd rather promise forty-five days and deliver in forty.
items.cn: 我们宁愿承诺四十五天，然后在四十天交付。

items.en: I'll put the full timeline in writing after this meeting.
items.cn: 会后我把完整的时间节点写成文件发给您。

items.en: I hear you — that's a fair point.
items.cn: 我明白您的意思，这话有道理。

items.en: Let me see what I can do, but I can't promise anything yet.
items.cn: 我看看能做什么，不过现在还不能打包票。

items.en: If you can increase the quantity, I can work on the price.
items.cn: 如果订单量能上去，价格方面我可以再去争取。

items.en: That's below our cost, so I'd be lying if I said yes.
items.cn: 这已经低于我们的成本了，说能做就是骗您。

items.en: What if we split the difference?
items.cn: 我们各让一步，怎么样？

items.en: Let's put that aside for now and come back to it later.
items.cn: 这一条我们先放一放，回头再谈。

items.en: So, where does that leave us?
items.cn: 那我们刚才聊到哪儿了？

items.en: Let me recap what we've agreed so far.
items.cn: 我把到目前为止达成的共识复述一遍。

items.en: I'll get the samples out to you within a week.
items.cn: 我会在一周之内把样品寄给您。

items.en: Could you share the drawings by Friday?
items.cn: 图纸能不能在周五之前发给我们？

items.en: Let's schedule a call next Tuesday to review the progress.
items.cn: 我们约下周二再通个电话，复盘一下进度。

items.en: Shall we call it a deal?
items.cn: 那我们就这么说定了？

items.en: I thought you might like to try some local food.
items.cn: 我想着您可能会愿意尝尝本地菜。

items.en: I booked a place about ten minutes from here.
items.cn: 我在附近订了一家餐厅，车程十分钟。

items.en: This restaurant is known for its roast duck.
items.cn: 这家店的招牌是烤鸭。

items.en: The host sits facing the door — please take that seat.
items.cn: 主位是正对门口那个，请您坐那里。

items.en: Please don't stand on ceremony.
items.cn: 您别拘束，随意些就好。

items.en: Make yourself at home.
items.cn: 就当在自己家一样。

items.en: Have you had Chinese food back home?
items.cn: 您在国外吃过中餐吗？

items.en: I'll order a few dishes and we can share everything.
items.cn: 我点几个菜，大家一起吃。

items.en: This one is mildly spicy; are you okay with a little heat?
items.cn: 这道是微辣的，您能吃一点辣吗？

items.en: These are dumplings; you dip them in this sauce.
items.cn: 这是饺子，蘸这个酱吃。

items.en: Try this one — it's their signature dish.
items.cn: 您尝尝这个，是他们的招牌。

items.en: If there's anything you'd rather not eat, tell me now.
items.cn: 有什么您不想吃的，现在就跟我说。

items.en: Let me get that for you.
items.cn: 我来帮您盛吧。

items.en: Can I top up your glass?
items.cn: 给您添一点酒吧？

items.en: Please, help yourself — don't wait for me.
items.cn: 您先请，不用等我。

items.en: I'd like to propose a toast to our future partnership.
items.cn: 我想提议这一杯，为我们以后的合作干杯。

items.en: Since you don't drink alcohol, water is totally fine.
items.cn: 您既然不喝酒，那以水代酒完全没问题。

items.en: That was a wonderful meal — thank you for having us.
items.cn: 这顿饭非常好，谢谢您招待。

items.en: Do you have any dietary restrictions I should know about?
items.cn: 您有什么忌口，需要我提前注意的吗？

items.en: Are there any foods you avoid for religious reasons?
items.cn: 有没有因为信仰方面需要回避的食物？

items.en: I've asked the kitchen not to use any peanuts.
items.cn: 我已经让厨房不放花生了。

items.en: I ordered two vegetable dishes, just in case.
items.cn: 我特意点了两道素菜，以防万一。

items.en: Would it help if I ask them to cook it separately?
items.cn: 要不要让他们单独做一份？

items.en: Please tell me if anything isn't working for you.
items.cn: 哪道菜您吃不惯，随时告诉我。

items.en: If you have some free time, I'd be happy to show you around.
items.cn: 如果您还有空，我很乐意陪您转一转。

items.en: There's a park nearby that's lovely at this hour.
items.cn: 附近有个公园，这个时间段特别好看。

items.en: This old street has been here for over a hundred years.
items.cn: 这条老街已经有一百多年了。

items.en: It's touristy, but worth seeing once.
items.cn: 这里游客是多，不过值得来看一次。

items.en: We can keep it short if you're tired.
items.cn: 如果您累了，我们就早点回去。

items.en: Whenever you'd like to turn back, just say the word.
items.cn: 您想回去了，随时说一声就行。

items.en: I'm afraid we need to make a small change to the schedule.
items.cn: 恐怕行程要做一点小的调整。

items.en: Mr. Chen was pulled into another meeting, so he'll join us at three.
items.cn: 陈总临时被叫去开会了，他三点过来找我们。

items.en: We're running about twenty minutes behind.
items.cn: 我们现在大约晚了二十分钟。

items.en: Nothing serious, just traffic.
items.cn: 没什么大事，就是路上堵。

items.en: Would you mind starting without him?
items.cn: 您介不介意我们先开始？

items.en: I'll keep an eye on the time and let you know.
items.cn: 我会盯着时间，有变化就告诉您。

items.en: Sorry about that — where were we?
items.cn: 不好意思，我们刚才说到哪儿了？

items.en: I'm afraid my English failed me for a second.
items.cn: 刚才我这儿英语卡壳了一下。

items.en: Let me rephrase that.
items.cn: 我换个说法。

items.en: I didn't catch that; could you say it again?
items.cn: 我刚才没听清，您能再说一遍吗？

items.en: I think we're saying the same thing in different ways.
items.cn: 我觉得我们说的是一回事，只是表述方式不同。

items.en: Let me take that offline so we don't hold everyone up.
items.cn: 这个我们私下再聊，不耽误大家时间。

items.en: I can't believe it's already time to say goodbye.
items.cn: 真没想到这么快就要送您走了。

items.en: Let me walk you to the car.
items.cn: 我送您上车。

items.en: Have a safe flight back.
items.cn: 回程一路平安。

items.en: I'll send the follow-up email tonight.
items.cn: 我今晚就把跟进邮件发出去。

items.en: Do let me know once you've landed safely.
items.cn: 落地之后记得告诉我一声。

items.en: We'd love to have you back — hopefully next time it's not all work.
items.cn: 欢迎再来，希望下次不只是谈工作。
